content: Sequence of execution of runnable entities Type: valid Description: The AUTOSAR templates shall provide means to specify constraints on the order of execution of different runnable entities. Rationale: In some cases, data dependencies between runnable entities cannot be used to deduce an order of execution among a set of runnable entities. Either such data dependencies are ambiguous and therefore lead not to a specific order of execution, or no data dependencies do not exist among runnable entities and an order of execution need to be enforced. Use Case: Analysis and validation of timing behavior Dependencies: [RS_SWCT_00090] Supporting Material: None
